text:
olivia: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands focused on security/privacy/compliance. Opening a thread for any leftover questions about SOC2/ISO, VPC/BYOK, audit logs, KMS, EU data residency, pen tests, and bug bounty. Panel: @mari, @raj, @jeff. Drop short Qs and we'll answer. :lock:

anika: Can you confirm EU data residency for Hosted customers? A few prospects asked if logs and data can be stored in eu-west-1 only.

mari: Short answer: yes, we offer EU-region-only data residency for Hosted tier customers on request. We deploy dedicated logical partitions and can ensure logs, metrics, and persisted artifacts remain in the EU region. We need a contract addendum for data processing terms.

anika: Is the SOC2 scope region-limited or global?

mari: SOC2 covers our global control environment (policies, access control, change management). For region-specific residency, evidence mapping will show logical controls but auditors care about control implementation company-wide. We'll provide customer-specific addenda when required.

jeff: Pen test / bug bounty schedule? Customers ask about external testing cadence.

raj: We run an internal full-scope pen test annually and rotate targeted app/infra tests every 6 months. We also maintain a private bug-bounty program with vetted researchers. We're evaluating moving to a public bounty next year; details and scope will be posted when formalized.

olivia: Audit logs: customers want immutable logs (WORM) for forensic timelines. Do we support write-once retention?

mari: For Hosted we offer immutable archival (WORM) to cold storage on request as part of an add-on SLA. Dedicated customers can enable an immutability policy on exported S3 buckets (we provide IaC templates). Private/on-prem customers control immutability.

jeff: KMS nuance: can we support per-tenant field-level encryption where keys are customer-specific?

mari: Yes. We support envelope encryption with per-tenant data keys encrypted under either Redwood-managed KMS or customer BYOK. For field-level use-cases we can provide SDK helpers and an example pattern that stores only encrypted blobs server-side.

anika: Rotation cadence expectations for Redwood-managed keys?

mari: Redwood-managed root keys rotate annually, data keys rotate more frequently (default 90 days). For Dedicated with high-security SLAs we can push to 30-day rotations. Customer-managed BYOK rotation schedule is under customer control.

tom: If a customer wants to audit the logs for billing disputes, how quickly can we provide signed exports?

jeff: We can produce signed, time-stamped exports within 3 business days by request. For customers on Dedicated or Enterprise, we offer automated nightly exports to the customer's S3 with optional server-side signing and checksum verification (SHA-256).

anika: Do exported logs include any encryption metadata so customers can verify key usage?
mari: Yes, exports include metadata fields: key_id (or masked key alias), envelope_algorithm, and key_version. For BYOK customers we'll include a cross-reference ID that maps to their key ARN without exposing secrets.

olivia: Any special controls for regulated verticals (healthcare/finance)?

mari: We have predefined compliance packages: HealthCare (HIPAA-aligned controls) and Finance (SOC2 + extra audit trails). These include stricter access reviews, quarterly control evidence pulls, and tailored retention options. Contact Sales + Security for SOW.

raj: A couple follow-ups we're committing to: (1) publish a one-page "EU data residency" cheat sheet; (2) upload the pen-test cadence and scope doc; (3) publish KMS BYOK patterns for envelope + field-level encryption. We'll link them here when published.

security-bot: Evidence owners: final upload deadline is 2025-09-30. Use the evidence portal: https://portal.redwood.com/evidence. Also note next internal pen-test window: 2025-10-12 to 2025-10-19. :rotating_light:⟲

jeff: For customers doing BYOK + Dedicated, we also provide a handshake test script to validate IAM policies before cutover. We'll add a troubleshooting FAQ to the docs.

anika: Is there a contact to coordinate EU residency legal paperwork?
mari: Reach out to @mari and Legal (legal@redwood.com). We'll create a template DP addendum to speed contracting.

tom: Thanks. One last Q: will audit logs include decision_reason for smart routing/fallbacks so we can debug model-level regressions?

mari: Yes 0% 1 logs include decision_reason, route, and model_version. We also store a salted prompt fingerprint to allow regression correlation without storing raw prompts.

olivia: Great thread 1 we'll consolidate to Confluence and publish the promised artifacts. If anyone has customer-specific follow-ups, DM the account lead and cc security. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
